BiblicalUsage: Zebed is a gift or an endowment, a good thing given by one person to another. Leah uses it after the birth of Zebulun, saying God has given her a good dowry, and she names her son for the gift she believes God has given her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Leah was right to call her children a gift, because every good endowment comes down from God whether we feel favoured or not.
